nodes.title: Product managers and product leaders
nodes.description: Write and maintain PRDs and briefs. Primary user.
nodes.quote: Primary: product managers and product leaders who write and maintain PRDs and briefs.

nodes.title: Cross-functional teammates (design and engineering)
nodes.description: Read PRDs and briefs to understand why a feature exists.
nodes.quote: Secondary: designers and engineers who read those documents to understand why a feature exists.

nodes.title: Produce a clear, well-grounded first draft in under 30 minutes
nodes.quote: A PM can produce a clear, well-grounded first draft in under 30 minutes.

nodes.title: Define success metrics tied to the user outcome
nodes.quote: A PM can define success metrics that are tied to the user outcome the feature serves.

nodes.title: Keep a document current as decisions change
nodes.quote: A PM can keep a document current as decisions change.

nodes.title: Understand a product area and trace any feature to its purpose
nodes.quote: A teammate can understand a product area and trace any feature back to its purpose.

nodes.title: Blank-page start: PMs copy an old document
nodes.quote: Product managers start most PRDs from a blank page or by copying an old document.

nodes.title: Drafts ship without a measurable success metric
nodes.quote: Drafts routinely ship without a measurable success metric

nodes.title: Documents go stale as decisions are made in Slack
nodes.quote: the finished document goes out of date as soon as decisions are made in Slack

nodes.title: Template-guided PRD drafting
nodes.description: Structured prompts for problem, users, outcomes and metrics.
nodes.quote: Template-guided PRD drafting (in flight): structured prompts for problem, users, outcomes and metrics.

nodes.title: Metric suggestion assistant
nodes.description: Suggests an input metric and an output metric for each outcome.
nodes.quote: Metric suggestion assistant (proposed): suggests an input metric and an output metric for each outcome.

nodes.title: Stale-document alerts
nodes.description: Notifies the owner when a document has had no edits or evidence for 30 days.
nodes.quote: Stale-document alerts (shipped): notifies the owner when a document has had no edits or new evidence for 30 days.

nodes.title: Decision log sidebar
nodes.description: Records decisions and reasons next to the text they affect.
nodes.quote: Decision log sidebar (proposed): records decisions and the reasons behind them next to the text they affect.

nodes.title: Shared area context panel
nodes.description: One panel with the users, outcomes and metrics for the area a document belongs to.
nodes.quote: Shared area context panel (in flight): one panel showing the users, outcomes and metrics for the area a document belongs to.

nodes.title: Dark mode editor
nodes.description: A dark theme for the editor.
nodes.quote: Dark mode editor (proposed): a dark theme for the editor.

nodes.title: Time to first draft
nodes.quote: Time to first draft: median under 30 minutes (currently about 90 minutes).

nodes.title: Share of PRDs with a defined success metric
nodes.quote: Share of PRDs with a defined success metric: 80% (currently about 45%).

nodes.title: Median days since last document update
nodes.quote: Median days since last document update: under 21.

nodes.title: New-teammate comprehension in 15 minutes
nodes.description: A new teammate can explain the area after 15 minutes.
nodes.quote: New-teammate comprehension: a new teammate can explain the area's users, outcomes and metrics after 15 minutes.

nodes.title: Ship stale-document alerts before the metric suggestion assistant
nodes.description: Decided 2026-09-14 by Priya Nair: stale documents were the most cited complaint in interviews.
nodes.quote: Priya Nair decided to ship stale-document alerts before the metric suggestion assistant, because stale documents were the most cited complaint in interviews.
